description: Disease throughput - layer plagues on a target, let them stack, then make every tick count for more.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_necromancer__death.txt and the 39 'death' nodes in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/necromancer.json. CoA calls this the Unholy/Blood Death Knight analog 'with an Affliction Warlock veneer' and its one-line summary is 'Pure disease throughput'. The tree spends accordingly: almost every node either applies a disease, extends one, or multiplies what one tick does. Its stat priority is Spell Hit > Haste > Spell Power > Crit > Intellect > Spirit/MP5, which is why Dark Harvester carries hit rating and Cycle of Death is a 5-point haste node at tier 0. CoA's own weakness list is the honest shape of it: 'Damage is stack-based ... so the first seconds of a burst opener find you weak', and 'There is no interrupt'.

nodes.name: Damnation
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Shadow damage by 5%, doubled against enemies below 35% health.' The below-35% doubling has no hook - _damage_multiplier never sees the recipient's health on a damage cast - so this is the flat half only. Every disease in this kit is Shadow, so it scales the whole spec.

nodes.name: Cycle of Death
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell haste by 5%.' Haste is second in this spec's own stat priority, behind Spell Hit.

nodes.name: Dark Harvester
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% and your hit rating by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike and hit chance by 3%.' Spell Hit leads the stat priority ('until your spells stop missing a +3-level target'), so the hit half is the point of the node.

nodes.name: Rotting Flesh
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Flesh to Worms by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Flesh to Worms by 25% and allows its periodic damage to scale with your spell haste.' DoT ticks do not read haste here, so the damage half carries the node.

nodes.name: Swarmer
nodes.description: Crypt Swarm has a 33% chance per rank to restore 4 Life Force.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the Runic Power generated by Crypt Swarm by 2 per tick.' An ability's `generates` amount is not talentable, so the extra fuel arrives as a proc on the same cast instead. Mechanically identical from the player's side: Crypt Swarm pays more.

nodes.name: Necrosis
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your diseases by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of your diseases by 25%.' dot_duration_pct is the real key, read on the DoT path.

nodes.name: Unholy Runes
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Crypt Swarm by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Crypt Swarm by 15%.' Crypt Swarm is the cast this spec presses most, so this is the deepest single-ability node in the tree.

nodes.name: Festering Decay
nodes.description: Reduces the Life Force cost of your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cost of Command spells by -15% and causes them to increase the target's spell damage taken by 10% for 15 seconds.' The enemy half is dead against monsters - Monster reads only armor and attack_power off its status effects - so the node is the cost reduction, widened from Command spells to everything because nothing groups abilities by CoA school.

nodes.name: Crypt Plague
nodes.description: Crypt Swarm and Lichfrost have a 33% chance per rank to apply Crypt Plague, a Shadow disease that stacks up to 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA's own level-10 passive: 'Damage dealt by Crypt Swarm now applies 1 stack of Crypt Plague and Lichfrost applies 2 stacks. Deals SP Plague Damage every 2 sec for 10 seconds, stacking 10 times.' Frontier has no free level passives, so it costs points. Two stacks from Lichfrost is not expressible (one proc, one stack), and the cap is 5 rather than 10 - no shipped stacking debuff goes past 5.

nodes.name: Plague Science
nodes.description: Increases the damage your periodic effects deal by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA's level-20 passive: 'Your diseases and Crypt Swarm now deal 100% increased damage to enemies below 20% health.' The execute condition has no hook on the DoT path, so it is an unconditional, far smaller DoT bonus.

nodes.name: Fiend
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Lichfrost by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage and critical damage of Lichfrost by 20% against diseased targets.' Nothing counts diseases on a target, so it applies always and at a fraction of the value.

nodes.name: Mutation
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow periodic effects by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'For the next 15 seconds your diseases mutate causing them to act with accelerated lethality, allowing your freshly applied diseases to tick -50% faster.' Tick RATE is not a thing in a turn engine; faster ticks are more damage, so that is what the node grants. shadow_dot_damage is assembled at runtime as f'{school}_dot_damage' - a literal grep calls it dead.

nodes.name: Expunge
nodes.description: Applying a disease increases your damage dealt by 5% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the target's damage taken from your Necromancer diseases by 10% for 10 seconds, stacking 2 times.' That is an enemy debuff, and a monster reads neither magic_damage_taken_pct nor spell_damage_taken_pct off its status effects, so the bonus is moved onto the caster where it works. One rank only: a proc's payload does not scale with points, just its chance, and this one is already at 100%.

nodes.name: Plague Revenant
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to apply Crypt Plague.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes now apply a stack of Crypt Plague.' Guaranteed in CoA; a chance here, because a multi-rank node needs something to scale and the chance is the only thing that does.

nodes.name: Apothecary's Cauldron
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3% ... In addition, increases your Magic damage dealt by 3%.' Only the self half can be a talent; the party haste is the ability of the same name.

nodes.name: Foul Contagion
nodes.description: Flesh to Worms lasts 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Applying Crypt Plague now extends the duration of Flesh to Worms on the target by 1 sec.' The trigger is not expressible, the effect is: ability_<id>_duration keys are built by interpolation in abilities.py.

nodes.name: Pandemic
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Virulency by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by your Undead minions now reduces the cooldown of Virulency by -1 sec.' A positive _cooldown_pct is a reduction (talented_cooldown), with a hard floor of 1 turn.

nodes.name: Rot Fetishist
nodes.description: Virulency hits for an additional 20% of its damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Virulency now applies Rot Fetishist for 10 seconds, causing you to replicate 20% of your periodic damage dealt as direct damage.' Nothing can read a running DoT's tick and mirror it, so the replication lands on the cast that would have applied it - bonus_pct adds extra damage to the same hit.

nodes.name: Creeping Plagues
nodes.description: Increases the damage your area effects deal by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'You may now Infest an additional target after using Virulency.' One more target is more area damage, and aoe_damage is the key the engine reads for every enemy_aoe cast - which is Virulency, Crypt Explosion's Corpse Explosion and the whole Animate line.

nodes.name: Touch of Death
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow spell power by 10 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Allows Expunge to stack an additional time and increases the range of your Death spells by 20%.' Neither stacking caps nor spell range exist here, so the node buys raw Shadow power instead - read by get_effective_spell_power, so it really does only scale the diseases.

nodes.name: Death Commander
nodes.description: Your damage spells have a 20% chance per rank to increase your haste by 20 for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to increase your and your Undead minion's haste by 20% for 8 seconds.' A DoT tick is not a proc trigger here, so it fires off the cast. The minion half cannot be reached by a buff.

nodes.name: Unholy Erosion
nodes.description: Increases your spell penetration by 20 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA's level-50 passive: 'Increases your spell penetration by 50, scaling with your level.' A real stat - take_damage subtracts the attacker's spell_penetration from the defender's resistance, on both Character and Monster.

nodes.name: Waking Crypts
nodes.description: Every disease you have running bites deeper, and the swarm itself hits harder.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Increases the damage of Crypt Plague by 50% and Crypt Swarm now deals 4% more damage for each Necromancer disease you have on the target.' The per-disease count has no hook, so the payoff is flat: the whole DoT pool and the whole Shadow school. Matches what CoA rates the spec on - 'It snowballs the longer your DoTs stay up.'
